title: Financial Statements
description: Annual Income Statement, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow for a single ticker, rebuilt from SEC XBRL facts via the equity_statement_* views. Highlights show the latest selected fiscal year against the year before; Trends chart the profit, margin, cash, balance-sheet and shareholder-return lines over the selected years; the statements below are line item x fiscal year tables, latest year first, in millions of the display currency (Balance sheet and Cash flow statement open with a click on their row). Fiscal years are labeled by the calendar year they end in. Money values are converted into the selected currency at each fiscal-year-end FX rate; share counts are never converted.

list.name: ticker
list.label: Ticker
list.query: SELECT i.symbol FROM instruments i WHERE i.kind = 'equity' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fundamentals f WHERE f.instrument_id = i.id) ORDER BY i.symbol
list.definition: SELECT i.symbol FROM instruments i WHERE i.kind = 'equity' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fundamentals f WHERE f.instrument_id = i.id) ORDER BY i.symbol

list.name: fiscal_year
list.label: Fiscal years
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year::text FROM equity_statement_annual a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') ORDER BY 1 DESC
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year::text FROM equity_statement_annual a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') ORDER BY 1 DESC

list.name: display_currency
list.label: Currency
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT split_part(unit, '/', 1) AS currency FROM fundamentals WHERE unit ~ '^[A-Z]{3}(/shares)?$' UNION SELECT currency FROM instruments ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT split_part(unit, '/', 1) AS currency FROM fundamentals WHERE unit ~ '^[A-Z]{3}(/shares)?$' UNION SELECT currency FROM instruments ORDER BY 1

list.name: latest_fy
list.label: Latest fiscal year
list.query: SELECT max(a.fiscal_year)::text FROM equity_statement_annual a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND a.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year)
list.definition: SELECT max(a.fiscal_year)::text FROM equity_statement_annual a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND a.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year)

panels.title: Highlights — FY$latest_fy vs the year before, $display_currency
Revenue
panels.description: Total revenue in the latest selected fiscal year. The arrow is the change from the fiscal year before. There is no arrow when the year before wasn't reported or wasn't positive: a change from zero or from a loss isn't a meaningful percentage.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT max(l.fiscal_year) AS fy FROM equity_statement_annual l WHERE l.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND l.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year)), a AS (SELECT a.fiscal_year, a.period_end, a.statement, a.line, a.value * (CASE WHEN a.currency IS NULL OR a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(a.currency, a.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', a.period_end), 0), 1) END) AS v FROM equity_statement_annual a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND (a.statement, a.line) IN (('income', 'Revenue')) AND a.fiscal_year BETWEEN (SELECT fy FROM latest) - 1 AND (SELECT fy FROM latest)), y AS (SELECT fiscal_year, max(period_end) AS period_end, max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'income' AND line = 'Revenue') AS v FROM a GROUP BY fiscal_year), cur AS (SELECT y.period_end, y.v FROM y WHERE y.fiscal_year = (SELECT fy FROM latest) AND y.v IS NOT NULL) SELECT COALESCE(p.period_end, c.period_end - 365)::timestamptz AS "time", CASE WHEN p.v > 0 THEN p.v ELSE 'Infinity'::float8 END AS "Revenue" FROM cur c LEFT JOIN y p ON p.fiscal_year = (SELECT fy FROM latest) - 1 UNION ALL SELECT c.period_end::timestamptz, c.v FROM cur c ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Op. income
panels.description: Operating income in the latest selected fiscal year. The arrow is the change from the fiscal year before. There is no arrow when the year before wasn't reported or wasn't positive: a change from zero or from a loss isn't a meaningful percentage.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT max(l.fiscal_year) AS fy FROM equity_statement_annual l WHERE l.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND l.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year)), a AS (SELECT a.fiscal_year, a.period_end, a.statement, a.line, a.value * (CASE WHEN a.currency IS NULL OR a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(a.currency, a.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', a.period_end), 0), 1) END) AS v FROM equity_statement_annual a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND (a.statement, a.line) IN (('income', 'Operating income')) AND a.fiscal_year BETWEEN (SELECT fy FROM latest) - 1 AND (SELECT fy FROM latest)), y AS (SELECT fiscal_year, max(period_end) AS period_end, max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'income' AND line = 'Operating income') AS v FROM a GROUP BY fiscal_year), cur AS (SELECT y.period_end, y.v FROM y WHERE y.fiscal_year = (SELECT fy FROM latest) AND y.v IS NOT NULL) SELECT COALESCE(p.period_end, c.period_end - 365)::timestamptz AS "time", CASE WHEN p.v > 0 THEN p.v ELSE 'Infinity'::float8 END AS "Op. income" FROM cur c LEFT JOIN y p ON p.fiscal_year = (SELECT fy FROM latest) - 1 UNION ALL SELECT c.period_end::timestamptz, c.v FROM cur c ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Net income
panels.description: Net income attributable to the company in the latest selected fiscal year. The arrow is the change from the fiscal year before. There is no arrow when the year before wasn't reported or wasn't positive: a change from zero or from a loss isn't a meaningful percentage.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT max(l.fiscal_year) AS fy FROM equity_statement_annual l WHERE l.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND l.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year)), a AS (SELECT a.fiscal_year, a.period_end, a.statement, a.line, a.value * (CASE WHEN a.currency IS NULL OR a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(a.currency, a.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', a.period_end), 0), 1) END) AS v FROM equity_statement_annual a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND (a.statement, a.line) IN (('income', 'Net income')) AND a.fiscal_year BETWEEN (SELECT fy FROM latest) - 1 AND (SELECT fy FROM latest)), y AS (SELECT fiscal_year, max(period_end) AS period_end, max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'income' AND line = 'Net income') AS v FROM a GROUP BY fiscal_year), cur AS (SELECT y.period_end, y.v FROM y WHERE y.fiscal_year = (SELECT fy FROM latest) AND y.v IS NOT NULL) SELECT COALESCE(p.period_end, c.period_end - 365)::timestamptz AS "time", CASE WHEN p.v > 0 THEN p.v ELSE 'Infinity'::float8 END AS "Net income" FROM cur c LEFT JOIN y p ON p.fiscal_year = (SELECT fy FROM latest) - 1 UNION ALL SELECT c.period_end::timestamptz, c.v FROM cur c ORDER BY 1

panels.title: EPS (diluted)
panels.description: Diluted earnings per share in the latest selected fiscal year. The arrow is the change from the fiscal year before. There is no arrow when the year before wasn't reported or wasn't positive: a change from zero or from a loss isn't a meaningful percentage.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT max(l.fiscal_year) AS fy FROM equity_statement_annual l WHERE l.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND l.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year)), a AS (SELECT a.fiscal_year, a.period_end, a.statement, a.line, a.value * (CASE WHEN a.currency IS NULL OR a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(a.currency, a.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', a.period_end), 0), 1) END) AS v FROM equity_statement_annual a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND (a.statement, a.line) IN (('income', 'EPS (diluted)')) AND a.fiscal_year BETWEEN (SELECT fy FROM latest) - 1 AND (SELECT fy FROM latest)), y AS (SELECT fiscal_year, max(period_end) AS period_end, max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'income' AND line = 'EPS (diluted)') AS v FROM a GROUP BY fiscal_year), cur AS (SELECT y.period_end, y.v FROM y WHERE y.fiscal_year = (SELECT fy FROM latest) AND y.v IS NOT NULL) SELECT COALESCE(p.period_end, c.period_end - 365)::timestamptz AS "time", CASE WHEN p.v > 0 THEN p.v ELSE 'Infinity'::float8 END AS "EPS (diluted)" FROM cur c LEFT JOIN y p ON p.fiscal_year = (SELECT fy FROM latest) - 1 UNION ALL SELECT c.period_end::timestamptz, c.v FROM cur c ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Free cash flow
panels.description: Operating cash flow minus capital expenditure in the latest selected fiscal year. The arrow is the change from the fiscal year before. There is no arrow when the year before wasn't reported or wasn't positive: a change from zero or from a loss isn't a meaningful percentage.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT max(l.fiscal_year) AS fy FROM equity_statement_annual l WHERE l.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND l.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year)), a AS (SELECT a.fiscal_year, a.period_end, a.statement, a.line, a.value * (CASE WHEN a.currency IS NULL OR a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(a.currency, a.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', a.period_end), 0), 1) END) AS v FROM equity_statement_annual a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND (a.statement, a.line) IN (('cashflow', 'Operating cash flow'), ('cashflow', 'Capital expenditure')) AND a.fiscal_year BETWEEN (SELECT fy FROM latest) - 1 AND (SELECT fy FROM latest)), y AS (SELECT fiscal_year, max(period_end) AS period_end, max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'cashflow' AND line = 'Operating cash flow') - COALESCE(max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'cashflow' AND line = 'Capital expenditure'), 0) AS v FROM a GROUP BY fiscal_year), cur AS (SELECT y.period_end, y.v FROM y WHERE y.fiscal_year = (SELECT fy FROM latest) AND y.v IS NOT NULL) SELECT COALESCE(p.period_end, c.period_end - 365)::timestamptz AS "time", CASE WHEN p.v > 0 THEN p.v ELSE 'Infinity'::float8 END AS "Free cash flow" FROM cur c LEFT JOIN y p ON p.fiscal_year = (SELECT fy FROM latest) - 1 UNION ALL SELECT c.period_end::timestamptz, c.v FROM cur c ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Total equity
panels.description: Shareholders' equity at the end of the latest selected fiscal year. The arrow is the change from the fiscal year before. There is no arrow when the year before wasn't reported or wasn't positive: a change from zero or from a loss isn't a meaningful percentage.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT max(l.fiscal_year) AS fy FROM equity_statement_annual l WHERE l.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND l.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year)), a AS (SELECT a.fiscal_year, a.period_end, a.statement, a.line, a.value * (CASE WHEN a.currency IS NULL OR a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(a.currency, a.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', a.period_end), 0), 1) END) AS v FROM equity_statement_annual a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND (a.statement, a.line) IN (('balance', 'Total equity')) AND a.fiscal_year BETWEEN (SELECT fy FROM latest) - 1 AND (SELECT fy FROM latest)), y AS (SELECT fiscal_year, max(period_end) AS period_end, max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'balance' AND line = 'Total equity') AS v FROM a GROUP BY fiscal_year), cur AS (SELECT y.period_end, y.v FROM y WHERE y.fiscal_year = (SELECT fy FROM latest) AND y.v IS NOT NULL) SELECT COALESCE(p.period_end, c.period_end - 365)::timestamptz AS "time", CASE WHEN p.v > 0 THEN p.v ELSE 'Infinity'::float8 END AS "Total equity" FROM cur c LEFT JOIN y p ON p.fiscal_year = (SELECT fy FROM latest) - 1 UNION ALL SELECT c.period_end::timestamptz, c.v FROM cur c ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Revenue and profit — $display_currency
panels.description: Revenue, operating income and net income per fiscal year.

targets.rawSql: WITH a AS (SELECT a.fiscal_year, a.period_end, a.statement, a.line, a.value * (CASE WHEN a.currency IS NULL OR a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(a.currency, a.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', a.period_end), 0), 1) END) AS v FROM equity_statement_annual a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND (a.statement, a.line) IN (('income', 'Revenue'), ('income', 'Operating income'), ('income', 'Net income')) AND a.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year)) SELECT fiscal_year::text AS "Fiscal year", max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'income' AND line = 'Revenue') AS "Revenue", max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'income' AND line = 'Operating income') AS "Operating income", max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'income' AND line = 'Net income') AS "Net income" FROM a GROUP BY fiscal_year ORDER BY fiscal_year

panels.title: Margins
panels.description: Gross, operating and net margin: each profit line as a share of revenue.

targets.rawSql: WITH a AS (SELECT a.fiscal_year, a.period_end, a.statement, a.line, a.value * (CASE WHEN a.currency IS NULL OR a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(a.currency, a.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', a.period_end), 0), 1) END) AS v FROM equity_statement_annual a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND (a.statement, a.line) IN (('income', 'Revenue'), ('income', 'Gross profit'), ('income', 'Operating income'), ('income', 'Net income')) AND a.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year)) SELECT fiscal_year AS "Fiscal year", 100.0 * max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'income' AND line = 'Gross profit') / NULLIF(max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'income' AND line = 'Revenue'), 0) AS "Gross margin", 100.0 * max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'income' AND line = 'Operating income') / NULLIF(max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'income' AND line = 'Revenue'), 0) AS "Operating margin", 100.0 * max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'income' AND line = 'Net income') / NULLIF(max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'income' AND line = 'Revenue'), 0) AS "Net margin" FROM a GROUP BY fiscal_year ORDER BY fiscal_year

panels.title: Cash generation — $display_currency
panels.description: Operating cash flow, capital expenditure (cash spent, shown positive as filed) and free cash flow (the difference).

targets.rawSql: WITH a AS (SELECT a.fiscal_year, a.period_end, a.statement, a.line, a.value * (CASE WHEN a.currency IS NULL OR a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(a.currency, a.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', a.period_end), 0), 1) END) AS v FROM equity_statement_annual a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND (a.statement, a.line) IN (('cashflow', 'Operating cash flow'), ('cashflow', 'Capital expenditure')) AND a.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year)) SELECT fiscal_year::text AS "Fiscal year", max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'cashflow' AND line = 'Operating cash flow') AS "Operating cash flow", max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'cashflow' AND line = 'Capital expenditure') AS "Capital expenditure", max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'cashflow' AND line = 'Operating cash flow') - COALESCE(max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'cashflow' AND line = 'Capital expenditure'), 0) AS "Free cash flow" FROM a GROUP BY fiscal_year ORDER BY fiscal_year

panels.title: Liabilities and equity — $display_currency
panels.description: What the company owes and what belongs to shareholders at each fiscal year end; together they fund the total assets.

targets.rawSql: WITH a AS (SELECT a.fiscal_year, a.period_end, a.statement, a.line, a.value * (CASE WHEN a.currency IS NULL OR a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(a.currency, a.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', a.period_end), 0), 1) END) AS v FROM equity_statement_annual a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND (a.statement, a.line) IN (('balance', 'Total liabilities'), ('balance', 'Total equity')) AND a.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year)) SELECT fiscal_year::text AS "Fiscal year", max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'balance' AND line = 'Total liabilities') AS "Total liabilities", max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'balance' AND line = 'Total equity') AS "Total equity" FROM a GROUP BY fiscal_year ORDER BY fiscal_year

panels.title: Cash and debt — $display_currency
panels.description: Cash plus short-term investments against short- plus long-term debt, at each fiscal year end.

targets.rawSql: WITH a AS (SELECT a.fiscal_year, a.period_end, a.statement, a.line, a.value * (CASE WHEN a.currency IS NULL OR a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(a.currency, a.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', a.period_end), 0), 1) END) AS v FROM equity_statement_annual a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND (a.statement, a.line) IN (('balance', 'Cash & equivalents'), ('balance', 'Short-term investments'), ('balance', 'Short-term debt'), ('balance', 'Long-term debt')) AND a.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year)) SELECT fiscal_year::text AS "Fiscal year", COALESCE(max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'balance' AND line = 'Cash & equivalents'), 0) + COALESCE(max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'balance' AND line = 'Short-term investments'), 0) AS "Cash & investments", COALESCE(max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'balance' AND line = 'Short-term debt'), 0) + COALESCE(max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'balance' AND line = 'Long-term debt'), 0) AS "Debt" FROM a GROUP BY fiscal_year ORDER BY fiscal_year

panels.title: Returned to shareholders — $display_currency
panels.description: Dividends paid and shares bought back each fiscal year.

targets.rawSql: WITH a AS (SELECT a.fiscal_year, a.period_end, a.statement, a.line, a.value * (CASE WHEN a.currency IS NULL OR a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(a.currency, a.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', a.period_end), 0), 1) END) AS v FROM equity_statement_annual a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND (a.statement, a.line) IN (('cashflow', 'Dividends paid'), ('cashflow', 'Share buybacks')) AND a.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year)) SELECT fiscal_year::text AS "Fiscal year", max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'cashflow' AND line = 'Dividends paid') AS "Dividends", max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'cashflow' AND line = 'Share buybacks') AS "Buybacks" FROM a GROUP BY fiscal_year ORDER BY fiscal_year

panels.title: Income statement — $display_currency millions
panels.description: Annual (10-K / 20-F) figures, latest fiscal year first, in millions of the display currency at each fiscal-year-end rate. Section headers are in blue. A blank cell means the company didn't report that line under a tag we track.

options.pattern: ^(Gross profit|Operating income|Pretax income|Net income|Total .*|.* cash flow|Net change in cash)$

targets.rawSql: SELECT m.line AS line, m.fiscal_year::text AS fy, m.value * (CASE WHEN m.currency IS NULL OR m.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(m.currency, m.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', m.period_end), 0), 1) END) / 1e6 AS value FROM equity_statement_matrix m WHERE m.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND m.statement = 'income' AND m.ord < 500 AND m.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year) ORDER BY m.ord, m.fiscal_year DESC

panels.title: Per share — $display_currency
panels.description: Earnings and dividends per share in the display currency; weighted average share counts in millions (never converted).

options.pattern: ^(Gross profit|Operating income|Pretax income|Net income|Total .*|.* cash flow|Net change in cash)$

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN m.line LIKE 'Weighted avg shares%' THEN m.line || ', millions' ELSE m.line END AS line, m.fiscal_year::text AS fy, CASE WHEN m.line LIKE 'Weighted avg shares%' THEN m.value / 1e6 ELSE m.value * (CASE WHEN m.currency IS NULL OR m.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(m.currency, m.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', m.period_end), 0), 1) END) END AS value FROM equity_statement_matrix m WHERE m.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND m.statement = 'income' AND m.ord > 500 AND m.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year) ORDER BY m.ord, m.fiscal_year DESC

panels.title: Balance sheet — $display_currency millions
panels.description: Point-in-time balances at each fiscal year end, latest first, in millions of the display currency at that day's rate. Section headers are in blue.

options.pattern: ^(Gross profit|Operating income|Pretax income|Net income|Total .*|.* cash flow|Net change in cash)$

targets.rawSql: SELECT m.line AS line, m.fiscal_year::text AS fy, m.value * (CASE WHEN m.currency IS NULL OR m.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(m.currency, m.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', m.period_end), 0), 1) END) / 1e6 AS value FROM equity_statement_matrix m WHERE m.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND m.statement = 'balance' AND m.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year) ORDER BY m.ord, m.fiscal_year DESC

panels.title: Cash flow statement — $display_currency millions
panels.description: Annual cash flows, latest fiscal year first, in millions of the display currency. Capex, acquisitions, dividends and buybacks are positive outflows, as filed.

options.pattern: ^(Gross profit|Operating income|Pretax income|Net income|Total .*|.* cash flow|Net change in cash)$

targets.rawSql: SELECT m.line AS line, m.fiscal_year::text AS fy, m.value * (CASE WHEN m.currency IS NULL OR m.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(m.currency, m.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', m.period_end), 0), 1) END) / 1e6 AS value FROM equity_statement_matrix m WHERE m.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND m.statement = 'cashflow' AND m.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year) ORDER BY m.ord, m.fiscal_year DESC
